description: Safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents (native Windows build)
notes: Unofficial x64 build of the NVIDIA OpenShell 'windows' branch (github.com/ns0m/openshell-windows). Not production-qualified.
Native sandboxing needs MXC, a host that passes 'wxc-exec --probe', and 'compute_driver = "mxc"' plus the absolute path to wxc-exec.exe in gateway.toml.
The binaries follow an unstable branch and can regress at any time.
